title: 27 measurement spaces censused across rewards/advantages/fitness/behavior/pools
body: Census 2026-10-19 origin/deepseek-engram-813 @9c9dfd13. Reward spaces: _compute_reward severity×action table (info/warning/error/critical) + success refine + duration shave; per-episode return (50 steps) averaged over N_EPISODES. Advantage spaces: REINFORCE raw, RLOO loo-deltas, R++ batch-z, GRPO group-z, DR-GRPO centered, GDPO multi-stream z-mean, CISPO weights/loss, DPPO rescale, SPOTracker. Preference: DPO/TI-DPO/InSPO/RAPPO + IPO/KTO/SimPO/SAPO/NGRPO. Step: SP-PRM prefix deltas. No-negatives: PU-AUC. Fitness: info/alert avg_reward + total (Q4 weight), fitness_skill idx, salt min-over-3, HOF margin rank. Behavior: QD z (40-artifact median/IQR), 4x4 grid (-2,2)^2, novelty 0.15, soft alpha 0.3, escape (3 trials, 507.82/9), VQ rule >9/16. Gates: margin 0.75, SPRT(.05,.10,0,.75), wins 2..6, holdout, canary. Verify: margin_check, run-failure est, divergence, asymmetric accept, preperiod/within-subject calibrate, epistemic/rubric/claim-index. Betting: bounded_margin(5.0), EProcess. Pools: info extract, alert severity-SQL, frozen snapshots, G3 N=10, intake 500. Routing: ESPO/DEPO band(.05,.95), pareto, Thompson/CMA, MCTS(c1.4,d2), GraphSAGE/GAT/PU-AUC.

title: Reward ceilings inventoried per severity; alert reachable max set by pool mix, not the table
body: Per-step maxima from the table: critical remediate 1.4 / alert 0.7; error remediate 1.0 (+0.3 success bonus) / alert 0.4; warning alert 0.7; info log 0.3. Episode cap 50 steps so critical-only episodes cap at 70 avg. Live store 2026-10-19: 382,797 memories, alert-eligible only 2,379 (error 1,484 + warning 887 + critical 8) vs info 380,376. The 8 critical rows make the 1.4 cell nearly unreachable; the alert arm effectively trains on error/warning maxima (1.0/0.7). 40-cycle alert max 36.92 vs j=3 edge ~36.2 (median 34.94 + IQR 1.235): reachable but marginal, and rolling norms Red-Queen the bar upward as the population improves. Prior hard-zero ceiling (critical unmapped, 35 cycles at 0.0) is fixed and documented in-table.

title: Zero-collapse and contamination guards verified live, not just read
body: Ran 2026-10-19 on 3.15t: grpo_const->[0,0,0,0], r++_const->[0,0], rloo_single->[0], gdpo_zero-stream->[-0.5,0.5] (no NaN anywhere; zero-variance streams contribute 0.0 by construction). _validate_rewards raises on empty/non-finite. Unmapped severity yields zeros AND records via note_unmapped_severity (visible, not silent). Anti-contamination: GA evals run persist=False (~96 evals/cycle write nothing); frozen pool snapshots stop the ~3pt live-window drift; EXCLUDED_TRAINING_SOURCES bars 8 training-system sources from pools; epsilon_decay is searchable without changing eval budget (no fake selection pressure); use_cutting_edge defaults off (result shape unchanged). Cross-space rule honored: run_policy_lab loss is explicitly NOT comparable across estimators (own docstring) — common-scale decisions go through bounded_margin.

title: QD calibration: novelty threshold rarely binds; j=3 needs novelty-weighted selection
body: Measured 2026-10-19 on state/qd_archive.json (12 cells): min pairwise elite distance 0.244, median 2.482 — the Q1 novelty threshold 0.15 sits BELOW every elite pair, so Dominated-Novelty admission would admit nearly any candidate and rarely binds; consider recalibrating toward ~0.2 or a rolling quantile. Admission already accepts any occupant for EMPTY cells, so novelty rules cannot fill (*,3) — only a candidate with alert z>+1.0 can, and 5 live cycles (incl. 2x alert weight) produced none. Escape gate verified working live (not-stuck 12 cells/677.91 -> correctly no trials). Remaining lever is novelty-weighted SELECTION in the GA loop (training/evolution lane), not admission, weighting, or more same-regime cycles.

title: Two open gaps: run-failure independence assumption and intake negative drought
body: Gap 1: verification_gate.estimate_run_failure assumes step-independence; temporal correlation (failure probability evolving over a run) is NOT modelled — the code states this residual openly, and any consumer treating p_fail as calibrated is over-reading it. Gap 2: training_intake marks NAT negatives (warning/error) and near-miss (warning) correctly per F2, but the live pool holds 0 negatives across 500 rows (synthetic probe aged out), so every negatives-gated measurement (#829) correctly STOPs. F2 emphasis stays out until per-worm hook identity exists (comment at training_intake.py:153). Neither gap blocks current lanes; both are recorded so the next session does not re-derive them.

title: GRPO replay wired in place: update_policy self-ingests, offline path opts out
body: ingest_replay_trajectory + replay_offline_step had zero callers (verified by grep). In-place fix 2026-10-19: update_policy gains record_replay=True default and buffers each live group as a trajectory (in-memory, 200-cap); replay_offline_step passes False so buffered steps are not re-buffered. update_policy success path returns None (test asserted presence, not value — first assertion caught this). 87/87 with grpo/mgpo/sota/learning-evolution/EP183 suites. Commit 7a36bcdb.

title: EP183 claim upgraded to two-direction drive; _claim probes stay for NO-HOST rows
body: _ep183 was a _claim existence probe over localize_violations. Now drives SMTVerifier(auto_record=False) through verify_constraints + judge_result on SAT/UNSAT fixtures: ACCEPT carries no localization key, REJECT names region n with repair (z3 solver live). Host ranking remains prior-lane cover (test_logicloc_localization, 6 tests); new file pins adapter + no-record discipline only — checked git log first to avoid overwriting. Commit 555634a3. Rule: empty-symbol _claim rows (141/153/278/352/404/405/402) stay claims; only existing symbols get driven.
